front: Revenue, profit and break-even for a bus?
back: Revenue = fare × passengers × trips. Profit = revenue − costs. Break-even passengers = costs ÷ (fare × trips).
Fuel prices, poor roads, breakdowns, competition, accidents, fare regulation and changes in demand.
